newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bankers Trust eyes Australasian rural assets.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bankers Trust eyes Australasian rural assets.

text.p: Fund manager Bankers Trust International Plc (BTI) was actively seeking investments in rural assets in Australia and New Zealand, BTI managing director Lawrence Hudson said on Monday.

"I was originally attracted because the water is cheap and the land is cheap and now there are a lot of agricultural companies in the Northern Hemisphere who are increasingly interested in getting into the Southern Hemisphere," Hudson told Reuters.
The London-based Hudson is in Australia to supervise BTI's fight to remove the manager of Rural Property Trust (RPT). BTI is RPT's largest unit holder with 19.6 percent.
Hudson said he was impressed by the quality of people managing rural water assets in Australia and saw significant opportunities in New Zealand.
"There's some fairly impressive people there (NZ). It's less regulated and there some quite interesting opportunities, but the prices are all a bit higher," he said.
Hudson said however that BTI's interest in rural assets in Australasia would have to go on hold until it had resolved its investment in RPT.
"I'm interested in all these other things, but I don't have time for anything at the moment until I get RPT back on track," Hudson said.
